scope: Plan-scoped counseling history, explicit preferences, current-context memory and answer review

verified: first question saves current plan and explicit preferences
Enter submission shows pixel loading and disables duplicate submission
new browser session restores preferences and conversations from saved plan
review correction with source is delivered to next question
evaluation totals and downloaded JSON contain three synthetic conversations and one review event
applying credit preferences produces semester caps 15,15,15,9
changed plan excludes all three old conversations and labels them as old context
final goal form shows complete term labels

limitations: No real student data sent to a remote model for these tests
Provider calls were mocked; real LLM factual quality or improvement was not measured
Reviewed corrections are user-confirmed notes, not official university approvals
Data is stored per plan, with owner checks in optional account mode; local mode is one shared local owner
No automatic training, no hosted conversations, no automatic import of exported chat histories
